title: UltraReal LoRA for FLUX.2 Klein 9B: less AI smoothness, more skin and fabric texture
summary: LoRAs that reduce the soft, smooth AI look and add texture and detail, best on close-ups and medium shots where skin and clothing texture matter. Versions KL9 V1 to V5 Pro are for FLUX.2 Klein 9B; the same page also has versions for Krea 2 and MOSS Image.
